# Module

`Module` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `module:type()`.

## Methods

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`type()`](type.md) | Get the type of the module. | 1.5.0 |
| [`protocol()`](protocol.md) | Get the protocol of the module. | 1.6.2 |
| [`enable()`](enable.md) | Get the state of the module. | 1.5.0 |
| [`option()`](option.md) | Get / Set one module option. | 1.6.0 |
| [`options()`](options.md) | Get the state of all module options. | 1.6.0 |
| [`muteSensorLost()`](muteSensorLost.md) | Mute all "Sensor lost" warnings from a module during a certain duration. | 1.6.0 |
